title: Insecure temporary file via tempnam (php) — review required
description: The php call tempnam creates temporary files with predictable names or unsafe semantics, so a local attacker can pre-create or replace the file (symlink attacks). This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms exclusive creation or switches to tempnam with immediate exclusive open.
remediation: Create temporary files with tempnam with immediate exclusive open, which opens exclusively with tight permissions.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any tempnam call matches regardless of directory protections.
